references.nair2013kani:
Ravi Sankar S\. Nair\.
Tribal Languages of Kerala\.
*Language in India*, 13\(7\):32–33, July 2013\.
The preface describes compiled material and incomplete fieldwork\. The chapter lists southern Kerala settlement regions but gives no exact elicitation site or consultant\. Source Roman forms preserve written doubled vowels and distinctive marks\.
URL: [https://languageinindia\.com/july2013/ravisankarkeralatriballanguages\.html](https://languageinindia.com/july2013/ravisankarkeralatriballanguages.html)\.
